meta.title: MafiaGameUA: Mafia online with cameras
meta.description: Play Mafia with cameras and microphones: 11 players and a host at one table.

hero.title: The city falls asleep.
hero.lede: Mafia with cameras and microphones. Eleven players, one host, and a table where you can see every face.
hero.tableLabel: A table for 11 players and a host
hero.lineup: 3 mafia, one of them the Don. 8 civilians, one of them the Sheriff.

game.title: How a game goes
game.lede: The game runs in rounds: day, night, day again. It ends when the mafia are found out, or when there are as many mafia as civilians.

steps.name: Introduction
steps.text: The first night. Everyone sees their role card, and the mafia open their eyes to recognise each other. All cameras and mics are off.

steps.name: Speeches
steps.text: Day breaks. The host gives the floor in seat order, and everyone has one minute to convince the table.

steps.name: Nominations
steps.text: During their minute, a player can put someone up for the vote by naming a seat number.

steps.name: Vote
steps.text: The table votes on the nominees. The player voted out says a last word, then the host turns off their camera and mic.

steps.name: Night
steps.text: The mafia shoot, the Don hunts for the Sheriff, the Sheriff checks a player. In the morning the host says who was killed.

host.title: The host runs the table
host.lede: The host sees every role and controls each player's camera and mic. A player can't turn back on what the host turned off.

items.name: Camera and mic
items.text: Turns them on or off for any of the eleven players.

items.name: Quiet table
items.text: One click leaves only the speaker's mic on.

items.name: Kill
items.text: Marks a player as killed, and their camera and mic stay off for the rest of the game.

items.name: Timer and fouls
items.text: Gives the floor, pauses the minute, records warnings.

footer.note: The first version runs on the host's own computer.

room.title: Rooms are being built
room.text: The next update adds a room with cameras for 11 players and a host.
